hooks.prompt: The user just finished a session in a self-learning vault covering mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, earth science, CS, and AI. Review the conversation and determine: (1) Did the user make an error revealing a recurring PATTERN (not a one-off typo)? (2) Did the user have a breakthrough or 'aha moment'? (3) Did the user report a study method working or failing? (4) Did the user discover a cross-domain connection? If ANY are true, output JSON: {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"Stop","additionalContext":"UPDATE_LEARNING_LOG: [subject] - [brief description of what to log]"}}. If none apply, output: {"decision":"allow"}
